about: Requests of the native client that are not a v000903 route the legacy server serves, each with the decision that keeps it (AN-18, #2897; spec R8). RequestPathsTest and RequestSitesTest (core-data) fail when an entry is no longer observed or a request outside this register appears.

exceptions.reason: The Cordova free-form weather fallback (_makeQueryUrlWithAddr in service.weatherutil.js), sent for a place with an address but no coordinates whose address has no KMA town (foreign free text, or 대한민국 alone). The legacy server's gateway answers every other /weather path with 404 (the AWS Lambda answered 501); the app shows the failure as the Cordova app does.
exceptions.decision: AN-06 (#2885): the free-form weather-address fallback is kept

exceptions.reason: The photo theme's feed, at the private build input TW_WEATHER_PHOTOS_URL, as the Cordova app's clientConfig.weatherPhotosUrl (loadWeatherPhotos). Without the input nothing is requested.
exceptions.decision: #2886 (AN-08): the photo theme loads the Cordova feed

exceptions.request: GET {a photo URL of the feed}
exceptions.reason: The photo the feed names for a place's weather (twUrls.regular), loaded by the app's PhotoLoader as the WebView loaded it.
exceptions.decision: #2886 (AN-08): the photo theme loads the Cordova feed

exceptions.request: SDK traffic: Places, Firebase (Messaging, Analytics, Remote Config, Crashlytics), Google Mobile Ads with UMP, and Google Play services location
exceptions.reason: The SDKs reach Google's endpoints themselves; the app builds no URL for them. Places runs only with a Places key, Firebase only with its configuration, Analytics only after the user's consent.
exceptions.decision: AN-06 (#2885) and AN-10, AN-14, AN-15: the Cordova app's providers through their native SDKs
